narrative.intro: Gardaworld Federal Services obligated $417M in FY2026 to date across 7 awards, with an average award size of $59.6M and obligations up 166.0% year over year. Gardaworld Federal Services shows higher FY2026 obligations than several prior years: FY21 $157M, FY23 $106M, FY24 $151M, and FY25 $157M. Gardaworld Federal Services earned the bulk of FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $313M. Gardaworld Federal Services also received obligations from the Department of State at $91M and the Department of Defense at $12.8M. Gardaworld Federal Services is concentrated in two NAICS markets: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services with $313M and Security Guards and Patrol Services with $104M. The note on the page states that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date. This snapshot shows a small number of large awards and strong DHS concentration driving FY2026 totals.

Gardaworld Federal Services has two primary NAICS markets: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at $313M and Security Guards and Patrol Services at $104M.
